question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&0\\3&k&4\\2&1&5\end{bmatrix}$, calculate $M_{11}$ and $M_{32}$. If these minors are equal, determine $k$ and verify the result.
explanation:
Calculation of $M_{11}$
$$M_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}k&4\\1&5\end{vmatrix}=5k-4$$
Calculation of $M_{32}$
Deleting the third row and second column gives $$M_{32}=\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}=4$$
Equality of the minors
Using $M_{11}=M_{32}$, $$5k-4=4$$ Therefore, $$k=\frac{8}{5}$$
Verification
For $k=\frac{8}{5}$, $M_{11}=8-4=4=M_{32}$.
